name: Remove Product Content for WooCommerce
author: WP Artisan

sections.description:
The Remove Product Content for WooCommerce plugin allows store owners to easily customize product pages by removing unwanted sections or elements without altering theme files or using custom code.

Ideal for optimizing the product page layout, the plugin provides a user-friendly interface where admins can disable specific content like the Add to Cart button, product price, image, descriptions, short description, rating, reviews, tags, additional information fields, or related products, giving them full control over the page design.

Perfect for:

  • Catalog-style stores (hide price & Add to Cart)
  • Wholesale or B2B shops
  • Clean and distraction-free product pages
  • Device-specific optimization (desktop vs mobile)

You can also display custom messages (like “Login to view price” or “Contact us for details”) exactly where you want.

Simplify and streamline WooCommerce product pages to create a cleaner, more focused shopping experience for customers.

Why Use This Plugin?

  • No coding required
  • Works with any WooCommerce theme
  • Clean and simple UI
  • Helps improve UX and conversions
  • Fully compatible with latest WooCommerce

Current Features( Free )

Single Product Page Controls

  • Hide specific elements:
    – Product Image (Thumbnail)
    – Price
    – Rating
    – Short Description
    – Add to Cart Button
    – Categories, SKU, Tags, Brands
    – Product Description
    – Additional Information
    – Reviews
    – All Product Tabs
    – Related Products
    – Sale Flash
  • Device-Based Control
    * Apply rules on:
    – Desktop
    – Mobile
    * Example: Hide price only on mobile
  • Custom Message System
    * Show message when elements are hidden
    * Example:
    – “Login to view price”
    – “Contact us for purchase”
  • Flexible Message Positions
    * Before/After Product Title
    * Before Short Description
    * Before/After Add to Cart
    * After Product Image
    * After Product Tabs
  • Message Styling Options
    * Text Color
    * Background Color
    * Text Alignment
    * Padding
    * Font Size

Shop & Archive Page Controls

  • Hide specific elements:
    – Product Thumbnail
    – Sale Badge (Flash)
    – Rating
    – Price
    – Add to Cart Button
  • Device-Based Control
    – Apply rules for Desktop and/or Mobile
  • Custom Message Support
    – Replace hidden elements with a message
  • Message Positions
    – Before Product Title
    – After Product Title
    – Before Add to Cart
    – After Add to Cart
  • Same styling options as product page
  • Easy to use
  • Translation ready

Premium features

Upgrade to unlock advanced control and targeting:

  • All Free Features
  • Advanced Visibility Rules
    * Apply rules based on:
    – Logged-in users / Visitors
    – User roles
    – Countries
  • Country-Based Restrictions
    * Hide content for specific locations
  • User Role Control
    * Show/hide elements for specific roles
  • Per-Product Settings
    * Override global rules for individual products
  • Exclude Conditions
    * Exclude specific:
    – Categories
    – Tags
  • Message Device Control
    * Show messages only on selected devices (desktop/mobile)
  • Priority Email Support
sections.installation:
1. Unzip the plugin and upload the remove-product-content-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. To change/modify plugin global settings, go to WooCommerce > Settings > Remove Product Content tab from WordPress admin area
  4. You are ready to use plugin
sections.faq:
Does it can remove the product thumbnail, sale flash, rating, price and add to cart button from product archive pages?

Yes, it has checked/unchecked options to remove these contents.

Does it can remove the product thumbnail, sale flash, rating, price short description, categories and sku, add to cart button, description, additional information, review, all product tabs and related products from the product details page?

Yes, it has checked/unchecked options to remove these contents.

Does it have an option to add a custom message for products?

Yes, you can add a custom message from the admin area which will be shown on the product archive and details page on different positions.

Does it can remove the product content for all users from specific countries?

Yes, but it is our premium feature. You need to upgrade to premium to get this feature.

Does it can remove the product content only for visitors?

Yes, but it is our premium feature. You need to upgrade to premium to get this feature.

Does it can remove the product content only for visitors from specific countries?

Yes, but it is our premium feature. You need to upgrade to premium to get this feature.

Does it can remove the product content for specific user roles?

Yes, but it is our premium feature. You need to upgrade to premium to get this feature.

Does it can remove the product content for specific user roles from specific countries?

Yes, but it is our premium feature. You need to upgrade to premium to get this feature.

Does it support overwriting global settings for individual products?

Yes, but it is our premium feature. You need to upgrade to premium to get this feature.

Can I control visibility for mobile and desktop separately?

Yes. You can apply rules based on device (Desktop / Mobile).
